# Review — PAN-4727
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI `lint-group (core)` is red on HEAD: `lint:agent-dir-removal` rejects the direct `rm` of Codex caches under `~/.overdeck/agents` in `src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts`

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4727-review-0749e890
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4727/.pan/review/agent-pan-4727-review-0749e890/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4727 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4727
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4735
- HEAD reviewed: 0749e8905f76e25d47a7cd224e8bac63dfbfd194 (equals `origin/feature/pan-4727`)
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base 75ec43c53d0b4f8609108c387e167ccb9dbb949f; no prior review cycle
- Note: during this review the workspace gained **uncommitted** edits to `src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts`, `src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts` and its test (a `removeCodexPluginCaches` door). Reviews evaluate the committed HEAD only; those edits are not part of this verdict.

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Codex-cache removal bypasses the agent-dir deletion door; CI core lint fails — `src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts:375`
- Severity: ! (a mandatory CI quality gate is red on the PR head, so the PR cannot merge)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (validation gate); in_pr_scope (WI-O7 `gstack-remove-sweep`, FR-14)
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `removePackFromMounts()` (new in this PR) builds `agentsRoot = join(getOverdeckHome(), 'agents')` and calls `rm(cache, { recursive: true, force: true })` on `<agent>/codex-home*/plugins/cache/overdeck-packs/<id>`. `scripts/guard-agent-dir-removal.sh` (PAN-3357) taints any variable derived from `getOverdeckHome(...'agents')` and rejects a direct `rm` outside `src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts`.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected a green `npm run lint`. Observed on CI run 41338832640, job `lint-group (core)`:
  ```
  ✗ direct agent state directory removal outside removeAgentStateDir:
  src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts:375:      await rm(cache, { recursive: true, force: true });
  Route directory cleanup through src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts.
  ```
  `npm run lint` is a `&&` chain, so every lint after `lint:agent-dir-removal` (`lint:skills`, `lint:slash-commands`, `lint:prompts`, `lint:file-size`, `lint:circular`, `lint:effect-facades`, `lint:effect-diagnostics`, `lint:docs`, …) did not run on CI for this head. The aggregate `lint` check is also red.
- Evidence: CI log for job 124944287653 (quoted above). The rm itself only deletes the pack's plugin-cache subdir, so no transcript is at risk in practice, but the repo rule requires agent-dir deletions to go through the one door.
- Fix: route the deletion through `src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts` (a narrow helper that removes only `<agent>/codex-home*/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>`, refuses symlinks and paths outside the agents root), call it from `removePackFromMounts`, commit and push, and confirm `lint-group (core)` turns green. The uncommitted workspace edit appears to do exactly this; it must be committed so CI and the next review see it.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. **~ `pack update` probes bun before the no-change check** — `src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts` `updatePack()`. `runtimePreview()` (pack-mode file + `bun --version`) runs before `if (commit === entry.commit && ref === entry.ref) return`. On a host without bun, `pan skills pack update gstack` with nothing to update fails with "needs bun on PATH" instead of reporting no change. Implementation defect, bounded; move the runtime preview below the early return.
2. **? Every launch walks the whole gstack extraction** — `listPackCatalog()` (`src/lib/skill-overrides/catalog.ts`) calls `readPackManifest(dir, 'gstack-runtime')`, which now walks the full tree (`listExecutables(root, '', RUNTIME_SKIP_DIRS)`, one `lstat` per file). That runs on every `resolveLaunchPackSelection()` and every catalog/store read. The live checkpoint shows ~232 executables, so the tree is a few thousand files at most; async and bounded. Hypothesis only; impact would need a launch-latency measurement. The executables list is only needed for the consent preview.
3. **? `pack gc` racing an in-progress `pack add`** — `gcPackRenders()` treats an id that is not yet registered as orphaned and deletes its `render/` and `state/`. A `pan skills pack gc` run while `pan skills pack add gstack` is rendering (registry not written yet) would delete the render mid-run; the add then fails on the marker check and writes nothing. Both are operator-run CLI commands, so this is unlikely; the outcome is a failed add, not a corrupt registry.
4. **? Project `.gstack/` listing keys on the literal id `gstack`** — `skillsPackRemoveCommand()` lists project `.gstack/` dirs only when `id === 'gstack'`. A gstack fork registered under another id with `--adapter gstack-runtime` gets the sweep but not the listing. Consider keying on the entry's adapter.
5. **~ Render gc ignores renders that live mounts still use** — `src/lib/skill-packs/render.ts` `gcPackRenders()`. `gcMounts` keeps any mount a `launch/*` link references, at any age, and reuse touches it. `gcPackRenders` protects only the *trusted* render; a non-trusted render goes by its own directory mtime, which is set when it is rendered and never touched again. After `pan skills pack update gstack` moves A→B, agents launched before the update still have mounts whose `SKILL.md` files call `render/A/bin/...` by absolute path. If A was rendered more than `--max-age-days` ago, the next `pan skills pack gc` deletes `render/A` at once, and those running agents' gstack skills fail until relaunch. The doc comment ("a running agent's render survives the same age as its mount") overstates the parity. Fix: pass the referenced mounts from `sweepLaunchLinks` into `gcPackRenders` and keep any render a referenced mount points at (or touch the render when a mount is built or reused from it). Bounded: it needs an update, a still-running older agent, and a manual gc.
6. **Process note: the verification-gate status overstates local coverage.** The `overdeck/test` status reads "typecheck+lint", but the local gate passed while CI `lint:agent-dir-removal` fails on the same head. This is not this author's defect.
7. **Live acceptance used `GSTACK_SESSION_KIND=spawned` in the hand-run `claude -p` command** (checkpoint lines ~224). Non-goal 4 forbids setting it in *Overdeck launches*; `git grep GSTACK_SESSION_KIND -- src` finds nothing, so the code complies. Noted only for traceability.

Imports only `node:*` + `./gstack.js` (NFR-3). |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** one blocker (CI guard). Add/update/sync ordering, failure cleanup, catalog readiness and launch root traced end to end; advisories 1, 3, 4.
- **Security:** the render runs trusted-at-consent code with `execFile` (no shell interpolation); paths come from `getOverdeckHome()` plus a validated id/commit; mounts still skip symlinks; nothing new is reachable from the dashboard server. No finding.
- **Performance:** advisory 2 only; no sync I/O, no `execSync`.
- **Requirements / UX:** see the matrix below. Non-goals checked: `launcher-generator.ts` untouched, no `GSTACK_*` env set in `src`, no dashboard UI files, project `.gstack/` dirs listed and not deleted.

## Verification
- CI run 41338832640 on HEAD 0749e89:
  - `lint-group (core)`: **fail** (`lint:agent-dir-removal`, quoted above); aggregate `lint`: fail.
  - `test-shard (2/4)` / aggregate `test`: **fail**. The only failure is `tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts` (`page.goto` 180 s timeout, then an `afterAll` hook timeout); 529 other files and 5634 tests passed. That spec came from main (PAN-4650, `8d26b6fb84f`), main's CI run at that SHA also concluded `failure`, and this PR touches no frontend or server code. Classified as unrelated to this PR, but it is still a red check on the head.
  - `test-shard 1/3/4`, `test-e2e`, `build (22)`, `lint-group (effect|skills|state)`, clean-install smoke, prompt-trailer gate, CodeRabbit: pass. `lint-group (effect)` covers `lint:effect-diagnostics` → pass.
- Focused local run (these modules are unchanged between the working tree and HEAD): `npx vitest run src/lib/skill-packs/__tests__/{render,gstack,adapters,sources}.test.ts` → 4 files, 70 tests passed.
- Lints CI skipped because of the early exit, run locally (working tree = HEAD plus the uncommitted mount/state-dir edits): `lint:file-size` ✓, `lint:circular` ✓, `lint:effect-facades` ✓, `lint:docs` ✓, `lint:source-introspection` ✓. `lint:slash-commands` ✗ locally, but the diff shows only main-side commands (`machines forward`, `conversations pull/reclaim`, `tell` description) missing from the **stale local `dist/`** (built 13:18); the committed manifest matches the branch's CLI, so this is not a finding.
- Not run: the full suite (CI owns it); `launch.test.ts`, `mount.test.ts`, `skills.test.ts` locally (they import the uncommitted `mount.ts`); CI shards cover them at HEAD.

## Scope Note
The work agent is already fixing the blocker in uncommitted edits. It must commit and push them, and the next cycle should confirm `lint-group (core)` is green. The `test` check also stays red until main's `linked-conversation-title-bar` e2e failure is fixed or quarantined; that failure is not this PR's.
